avr-notecpp.comment: Style 1: typed API groups via Api<UnstructuredCtx, StaticNotecard<SerialStack>>. The most common StaticNotecard usage.

avr-notecpp-direct.comment: Style 2: nc.execute(req) bypassing the Api groups. Drops a layer of group thunks.

avr-notecpp-raw.comment: Style 3: transact_dispatch(BuildFn, ...) raw entry — bypasses StaticNotecard entirely.

avr-notecpp-multistack.comment: Two distinct StaticNotecard<...> types in one TU (HardwareSerial stack + mock stack). Validates that thunk/closure dedup compounds: doubling the Notecard count adds ~5.4 KB / ~370 B, not 2x single-stack. Gate floor catches lost sharing.
